ov: Over 6,000 species of small, domed beetles, often red with black spots that warn predators they taste bad. Most eat aphids and scale insects, which makes them welcome in gardens, though some species attack crops or crowd into homes in winter.

why.h: In temperate areas ladybirds hibernate through winter, gathering in clumps; tropical species go dormant in the dry season.

df: Mostly aphids and scale insects; some eat plants or fungi.
fx: An adult lives up to a year.
In a study in Britain, ladybirds flew as far as 120 km, at 30 km/h and nearly 1,100 m up.
